recipes.name: Crispy Eggplant
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53072. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Slice eggplant into 1 cm (0.4-inch) slices. Place them in a bowl and sprinkle them with salt. allow them to sit for 30 minutes to render some of their liquid and bitterness.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 2. After 30 minutes wash eggplant slices from salt and pat dry with a kitchen towel.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 3. In a large bowl/plate place breadcrumbs and sesame seeds. In another bowl beat 2 eggs with pinch salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 4. Heal oil in a large skillet over high heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 5. Dip eggplant slices in egg, then in crumbs, and place in hot oil. Fry 2 to 3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown. Drain on a paper towel.

recipes.name: Grilled eggplant with coconut milk
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53074. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: .  Prepare the eggplants for grilling by pricking them all over with a fork.  This is so it won’t burst during the grilling process as the natural water in it heats up.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 2.  Grill the eggplants, turning them over frequently to ensure even cooking.  Grill until the skins are dark brown, even black and the eggplant is soft when you touch it.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 3.  Soak the grilled eggplant in a bowl of water to cool it down.  Peel the skin off the eggplant.  Place the whole eggplants in a shallow dish (my mom actually cuts the eggplant into small, bite-sized pieces).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 4.  In a small mixing bowl, mix together the coconut milk or cream, lemon powder, salt and hot pepper.  Mix until the lemon powder and salt dissolve.  Taste, then adjust the amount of lemon powder, salt and hot pepper to your liking.  Pour the mixture over the eggplant.  Sprinkle the green onions over the eggplant and coconut milk.  Stir gently to combine.

recipes.name: Tortang Talong
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53075. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 0.	Grill the eggplant until the color of skin turns almost black

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 1.	Let the eggplant cool for a while then peel off the skin. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 2.	Crack the eggs and place in a bowl

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 4.	Place the eggplant on a flat surface and flatten using a fork.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 5.	Dip the flattened eggplant in the beaten egg mixture

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: 6.	Heat the pan and pour the cooking oil

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: 7.	Fry the eggplant (that was dipped in the beaten mixture). Make sure that both sides are cooked. Frying time will take you about 3 to 4 minutes per side on medium heat.
